# Chelsey Fanning

> Chelsey Fanning is the customer-facing practice of Chelsey Fanning, a licensed Idaho REALTOR® with eXp Realty. She helps buyers and sellers in Post Falls, Coeur d'Alene, Hayden, Rathdrum, and Spirit Lake. Contact is a request for a conversation, not an instant booking.

## About
Licensed Idaho REALTOR® (License LC54829) with eXp Realty in Post Falls, Idaho. Markets: Post Falls, Coeur d'Alene, Hayden, Rathdrum, Spirit Lake, and North Idaho. Public site copy includes 7+ years serving North Idaho. Google rating published on this site: 5.0 from 27 reviews. No luxury-specialist designation is claimed.
